traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP are satisfied. The plugin is implemented as a standard ESLint plugin module in TypeScript, compiled to a publishable npm package with appropriate main/types entries. src/index.ts dynamically loads and registers all core traceability rules into a rules map, exposes flat-config presets (recommended and strict) compatible with ESLint v9, and attaches a maintenance API. Error handling for rule loading failures is implemented via a try/catch around dynamic requires, with console logging and a placeholder rule that reports an explicit diagnostic; this is verified by tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts. CLI-level behavior and ESLint v9 flat config integration are validated by tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts and tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts, which spawn the real ESLint CLI using eslint.config.js and assert expected exit codes and messages. User-facing documentation in README.md provides clear installation and configuration instructions, including flat-config examples and a quick start flow, and internal docs describe rule development best practices. The presence and passing of multiple story-referenced tests tied to this story (plugin-setup, plugin-default-export-and-configs, plugin-setup-error, cli-error-handling, CLI integration) provide strong, concrete evidence that the plugin structure foundation, configuration system, ESLint v9 integration, error handling, and documentation are all in place. Therefore this story is fully implemented and marked PASSED.
